messages:
mel: opened a small PR to standardize 'account' vs 'tenant' language across the Dedicated provisioning handbook + add runnable snippets. PR: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/2791. Quick sanity checks please.

anika: thanks mel. reviewers always want copyable examples. Can we include a Rust SDK and a compact terraform snippet this time? makes the doc feel more complete.

mike: adding TF now. I'll also show a label mapping example for account->pool assignment so platform teams can copy it.

nina: I pushed a Rust SDK example to the PR, please check names. snippet: ```rust
let client = redwood::Client::new(env!("RW_KEY"));
let req = redwood::dedicated::CreateReservation { account_id: "acme-io".into(), gpus: 2, region: "us-west-2".into() };
let res = client.dedicated().create_reservation(&req).await?;
println!("reservation id: {}", res.id);
```
Is this idiomatic?

docsbot: CI: lint OK. linkcheck: 2 warnings -> (1) old terraform path /terraform-examples/dedicated/reserved_pool.tf (suggest using /infra-samples/terraform/dedicated/reserved_pool.tf), (2) broken image link in diagrams/reserved-pools.png.

mike: TF snippet added: ```hcl
resource "redwood_reserved_pool" "acme" {
  account = "acme-io"
  gpu_count = 2
  region = "us-west-2"
  labels = { env = "prod", team = "recommendations" }
}
```
Note: field is `gpu_count` in the new provider. Also added mapping comment for labels -> account.

anika: good catch about the image. mel, can you swap diagram path to /assets/images/reserved-pools-v2.png or drop it for now?

mel: swapped to /assets/images/reserved-pools-v2.png. Also added two autoscale profiles in the PR: latency-sensitive and cost-optimized. Example YAML: ```yaml
# latency-sensitive
autoscalePolicy:
  minInstances: 2
  scaleUpCooldown: 30s
  scaleDownCooldown: 300s
  maxBurst: 1

# cost-optimized
autoscalePolicy:
  minInstances: 1
  scaleUpCooldown: 90s
  scaleDownCooldown: 180s
  maxBurst: 4
```

nina: Rust snippet looks fine to me, matches v0.9-rs. tiny nit: use `account_id` consistently (not `account`) in docs.

docsbot: reminder: runbook link check -> /ops/runbooks/dedicated-fallback currently 404. Consider redirect or point to /runbooks/dedicated/fallback.

infra: we can add a redirect rule for /ops/runbooks/* to /runbooks/*, will do once PR references confirmed.

mel: last item for legal: SLA line. Draft in PR: "99.9% monthly availability for Dedicated reserved pools during committed windows, subject to documented exclusions and service credit remedies." Legal, please review.

legal: prefer that line but require explicit exclusions listed inline (scheduled maintenance with notice, force majeure, customer misconfig, third-party provider capacity failures). Also cap service credits to monthly bill. Add those and ping back.

anika: added exclusions and the service-credit cap per legal. owners: docs (mel), infra (mike), SDK (nina), legal (legal). Once infra confirms redirect and legal OKs, I'll merge.

mel: thanks all, merging after approvals. :white_check_mark:
